headlines.answer: ADM is worth about $46.88 a share (range $10.79–$109.89), 31% below the $67.47 share price.
headlines.field: The methods are 274% apart: the DCF gives $19.76, sector comps $73.99, so the weights decide the answer.
headlines.spread: 80% of 2,000 simulated runs land between $0.55 and $120.11; about 10% of runs are above the $67.47 price.
headlines.sensitivity: Each 0.5-point change in the discount rate moves value about $3.58 a share; the grid spans $11.78–$37.75.
headlines.comps: Peers' multiples imply $73.99 a share (range $21.02–$99.67); EV/Sales gives the highest median at $73.99.
headlines.dcf: The DCF's $19.76 a share rests 54% on the terminal value.
